links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified radiology reports (320 reports rated by 16 non-medical participants)
links.outcome: Layperson comprehension (5-point Likert) of LLM plain-language reports versus original reports
links.effect: Mean comprehension: original 4.32 ± 0.80; ChatGPT-4.0 4.55 ± 0.68; Grok-3 4.69 ± 0.56; DeepSeek-R1 4.80 ± 0.49. Effect sizes: DeepSeek-R1 r = 0.81, Grok-3 r = 0.74, ChatGPT-4.0 r = 0.49. All adjusted P < 0.05.
links.tradeoff: Radiologists found omissions and inaccuracies in the LLM versions. Omissions per report: ChatGPT 0.072, Grok 0.047, DeepSeek 0.093. Inaccuracies per report: ChatGPT 0.038, Grok 0.069, DeepSeek 0.05. Some anatomical location details were lost. Outputs were inconsistent across repeated runs. Musculoskeletal reports benefited less.
links.quote: Compared to the original reports, all LLM-generated versions demonstrated statistically significant improvements in comprehension (all adjusted P < 0.05 after Bonferroni correction), as illustrated in Fig. 1 .

design_hint: LLM-simplified patient-facing radiology reports (reading-level simplification) versus original reports
